title: Benchmark indexer + fingerprint graph + cohort diff UI for regression triage
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Deliver a metadata-first benchmark result indexing pipeline plus an investigative UI that surfaces regression signatures across tokens/sec, p95 latency, and token distribution. Core pieces: (1) a canonical ingestion & normalization job that accepts benchmark harness outputs (load-runner, bench-playback, telemetry snapshots) and computes a compact 'benchmark_fingerprint' (vectorized deltas across key metrics + histogram signatures); (2) a fingerprint graph store that links similar regressions to common root causes and exposes time/commit spans; (3) a cohort-diff heatmap UI that compares baseline vs candidate runs with drilldown to per-route traces, sample prompts, and KV/cache hit distributions; (4) an automated triage scorer that ranks anomalies by impact and attaches an evidence bundle (artifacts: replay feeds, latency traces, kernel selection logs, model variant metadata). This ticket covers the storage schema, indexing pipeline, UI surface for comparison/triage, and the runbook automation for creating triage items with suggested owner and rollback hints.
acceptance_criteria: Indexing pipeline consumes bench output (bench-playback, load-runner) and telemetry JSON and writes canonical records with a stable 'benchmark_fingerprint' field
Fingerprint graph can link runs by similarity > 0.7 and returns top-5 related nodes within 200ms for queries on our staging dataset
Cohort-diff UI shows tokens/sec and p95 delta heatmap, allows selecting a cell to open an evidence bundle with sample prompts and replay links
Automated triage creates a draft triage ticket with prioritized score, suggested assignee, and attached evidence bundle for top regressions in nightly runs
End-to-end test coverage for ingestion -> index -> UI drilldown implemented and flakiness < 5% in CI
Documentation and runbook added to Confluence with steps to run replays and escalate to SRE/Runtime teams
implementation_steps: Design storage schema: add benchmark_fingerprint (base64 vector), summary fields (tokens_per_sec,p95,median,req_count), and retention flags
Prototype ingestion lambda that normalizes existing benchmark outputs into canonical JSON with deterministic fingerprinting
Build fingerprint graph service (lightweight vector index + metadata store) with approximate nearest neighbor search
Extend bench results UI backend endpoints to return cohort diffs and per-run evidence bundles
Design frontend cohort-diff heatmap component and fingerprint graph explorer (React + D3), wire to backend endpoints
Implement triage scorer: impact = delta_tokens_sec*req_count + delta_p95*latency_weight + customer_impact_factor
Hook triage automation to create draft Linear tickets (or internal triage docs) and attach evidence bundle links
Add retention/compaction job to collapse old daily runs into weekly summaries to keep index size bounded
notes: Tradeoff: fingerprint vector dimensionality vs. index latency — prototype at 64 dims, evaluate recall/latency before increasing
Retention goals: keep full daily runs for 30d, weekly summaries for 1y; storage cost estimate attached in Confluence
We should reuse existing evidence bundle format from ENG-91234 to keep replay tooling compatible
Security: evidence bundles may contain PII in sample prompts; must run redaction step before index and mark bundles as redacted
Potential future: attach kernel selection traces (cuDNN/TVM metadata) to fingerprints to correlate regression to kernel changes
